issues.issue: Are the claimant's allegations of abuse by her father credible, including the supporting letters?
issues.applicant_position: Her father abused her verbally and physically from age 12 and attacked her sister; she did not report due to church teachings and police inaction.
issues.result_text: On balance, claimant was not verbally or physically assaulted; the allegations do not establish an objective fear of persecution.

issues.issue: Is there a serious possibility she will be persecuted by her father or anyone else if returned to St. Vincent?
issues.applicant_position: She fears persecution by her father if she returns.
issues.result_text: There is no serious possibility the claimant will be persecuted by her father if returned to St. Vincent.
